liam: Quick async — starting canary for feature flag beta_ui in eu-west-1 in ~30m. Posting short standup (what I did / blockers / today).

liam: What I did: validated configs, smoke run on canary infra, prewarmed KV cache, pushed flag config to stage.
liam: Blockers: noticed higher 95p latency on slice-7 during load tests (~120ms vs 80ms). Root cause unclear.
liam: Today: will monitor warmup + run gradual 5% -> 25% over 45m, coordinate with infra for cache eviction tweak.

maria: Acked. I'll watch infra metrics and handle any cache policy changes. If latency reappears I'll roll back to cached variant.

ajay: Checked rollout script. One note: the lift command needs the shard arg otherwise it targets all regions.
ajay: Run: `redwood ff lift --flag beta_ui --slice slice-7 --percent 5` (dry-run first)

sasha: I'll keep an eye on user-facing errors and traces. Added an alert on 5xx increase for /chat endpoint :rotating_light: 

deploy-bot: deploy created by liam for beta_ui-canary, id:d-3345 — target slice-7 — scheduled t+30m.

maria: small ask — can you share the dashboard link? I want to open infra logs asap.
liam: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rollout/beta_ui/slice-7

emma: Noted blocker: infra will have a rolling kernel patch finishing in 20m; might impact pod restarts. If it overlaps, do NOT widen beyond 5%.

liam: Good catch @emma — we'll keep at 5% until patch completes. If restarts happen, pause and notify.

ajay: I'll prep a quick rollback command: `redwood ff set --flag beta_ui --percent 0 --slice slice-7` and pin it in runbook.

sasha: tagging @support-team so they can watch for tickets. Also adding a canary prompt set for regression checks.

liam: OK — summary: start 5% in 30m, infra watches, keep at 5% if kernel patch still running, rollback command ready. Ping here with any immediate flags.

maria: :thumbsup:
ajay: 👍
sasha: ✅
